description: Backend validation of the Phase 17 AIMS-inspired angle-precision diagnostic. The campaign checks whether a moderate n=4 smooth Grover-Rudolph law behaves near the local shot-noise prediction or shows backend-dominated TVD.
rationale: Phase 17 predicts that finite-shot TVD dominates deterministic angle quantization for b >= 16.
Existing QPU results already cover gr_sin2_n3, gr_affine_n5, gr_beta_bump_n5, and gr_gaussian_sigma025_n6.
The missing smooth grid-refined control is gr_sin2_n4, which has 16 cells and should be less demanding than n=5 or n=6 cases.
The result will test whether the transition from n=3 to n=4 remains near the local shot-noise scale or is already backend-dominated.

selected_cases.label: sin2 midpoint law, n=4
selected_cases.purpose: Grid-refined smooth validation case for the Phase 17 angle-precision versus shot-noise prediction.

stopping_rules: Run first without --submit and inspect depth and two-qubit count.
Submit only if the circuit remains below the current controlled-depth regime for direct Grover-Rudolph distributions.
After retrieval, run scripts/phase17_backend_check.py including the new fetched JSON.
Classify the case as shot-compatible only if backend TVD is below the local Phase 17 p95 for the same shot count.
